Integrating a polar cap over one pentagon, its clipped segment has S′(t)=2 sin(t) α(t), α=arccos(tanρ/tan t). Twelve normalized cells yield F(t)=6(1−cos t)−15S(t)/π between ρ,R, with cap CDF below and total coverage above. Expanding α at ρ proves the 3/2 threshold, and F′(R−)=0,F″(R−)<0 the quadratic uncovered tail; the spherical Laplacian identity Δ(u·v)=−2(u·v) with constant outward edge derivative −sinρ gives the exact chord moment 2−15ℓsinρ/π. Independently evaluated scalar moment 0.1682513876492615 and endpoints rho=0.5535743588970452,R=0.6523581397843682.
